summary.zh: 了解技能质量的评分维度与档位
summary.en: Understand how skill quality is scored across dimensions.

description.zh: 说明技能质量 0 到 100 分的评分维度、评审判据和计算方式，并交代各层结果的可信度。某一维度得分偏低、想提升触发准确度，或要设定合格阈值时使用。
description.en: Explains the dimensions, rubrics and formulas behind a 0 to 100 skill quality score, and how far to trust each layer. Use it when one dimension scores low, triggering accuracy needs work or thresholds must be set.
